query:
SELECT 
  p.id as productId,
  p.name as productName,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as saleDate,
  s.saleDate as saleDateFull,
  SUM(si.quantity) as quantity,
  SUM(si.totalPrice) as revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as numSales
FROM saleItems si
INNER JOIN sales s ON si.saleId = s.id
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE s.status != 'CANCELLED' 
  AND p.name = 'Baly Maça Verde 2l'
  AND s.saleDate >= '2025-12-01'
  AND s.saleDate < '2025-12-06'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, DATE(s.saleDate), s.saleDate
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
